key_concepts: Wastes have observable characteristics such as texture, weight, and flexibility.
Wastes can be sorted into disposable, reusable, and recyclable groups.
Food scraps and plant wastes can be disposed and decompose into soil.
Rotten food scraps can turn into rich soil that helps gardens grow.
Some waste materials can be reused for a new purpose.
Some waste materials can be recycled into new useful items.
Common household wastes include food leftovers, peelings, twigs, weeds, cartons, bottles,
Materials can be grouped by similar properties such as smooth, rough, heavy, light, bendab
Safety precautions should be observed when disposing rotting wastes.
Safety precautions should be observed when reusing and recycling waste materials.
Reusing and recycling help keep the environment clean and green.
